zones.name: The Vessel
zones.fingerprintHint: Primary game world traversed by MIO; contains tubes, icy sections, large gaps, and various enemy encounters
zones.note: All core abilities are used and acquired within The Vessel

abilities.name: Hairpin Grapple
abilities.grants: Grapple-based navigation; chain grapple points while maintaining momentum; cross large gaps
abilities.note: Available early in the game; essential for navigation throughout The Vessel

abilities.name: Aerial Combat & Jump Reset
abilities.grants: Resets double jump on airborne hit; enables extended airborne traversal and platforming
abilities.note: Unique mechanic; hitting any enemy or environmental object while airborne resets double jump

abilities.name: Arachnid Locomotion
abilities.grants: Wall cling and ceiling navigation; spider-like movement
abilities.note: Also called Strider or wall cling; requires energy; tip: avoid jumping while using it in tubes or icy sections to conserve energy

abilities.name: Gliding
abilities.grants: Crossing large gaps and accessing new areas
abilities.note: Available around 8 hours into the game; consumes energy; later-game acquisition

abilities.name: Dash/Deflect
abilities.grants: Perfect dodge / parry-block mechanic in combat
abilities.note: Does not provide time slowdown or counterattack; has a cooldown; requires precise timing; makes combat more engaging once unlocked

abilities.name: Orbs
abilities.grants: Ranged projectile attacks; effective against flying and hard-to-reach enemies
abilities.note: Can combo with melee and aerial combat for extended combinations

abilities.name: Decoy Clones
abilities.grants: Spawn decoy clones to distract enemies and attack from unexpected angles
abilities.note: Useful in boss encounters to create safe attack windows; adds strategic depth to combat
